description: This file defines reusable React components for rendering accessible and styled HTML table elements, including Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableHead, TableRow, TableCell, and TableCaption. It exports these components for use in other parts of the application.

methods.name: Table
methods.description: A React component that renders a styled <table> within a container div, accepting standard table properties.

methods.name: TableHeader
methods.description: A React component for rendering a styled <thead> element.

methods.name: TableBody
methods.description: A React component for rendering a styled <tbody> element.

methods.name: TableFooter
methods.description: A React component for rendering a styled <tfoot> element.

methods.name: TableRow
methods.description: A React component for rendering a styled <tr> element.

methods.name: TableHead
methods.description: A React component for rendering a styled <th> element.

methods.name: TableCell
methods.description: A React component for rendering a styled <td> element.

methods.name: TableCaption
methods.description: A React component for rendering a styled <caption> element.
